claims.claim: Neatly UK used Xbox One available with 2 pads and in good condition.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show an Xbox Series S style console (white body with Xbox logo on the right and perforated mesh side), not an Xbox One.

claims.claim: Comes with Fc26 Package and other...
claims.evidence: No photo shows what 'Fc26 Package' contains.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired.
claims.evidence: Photos do not show seals, internal access, repair marks, or opening evidence.
Photos cannot confirm overheating or thermal behavior.
Photos do not test HDMI/USB/power ports.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: Photos show two controllers, but do not show receipt or confirm they are 'original' or the exact controller models.

risks.risk: Wrong console model (Xbox One claimed, but photos indicate Xbox Series S). This affects compatibility, value, and buyer expectations.
risks.proof: A photo of the console label/serial sticker showing the exact model (e.g., 'Series S') and a screenshot of System > Console info.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case mismatch: treat as not-confirmed model and value closer to the lower/least certain option until model is verified.

risks.risk: Power-on/boot status unknown (could be dead, stuck, or faulty even if it looks intact).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the console powering on and reaching the dashboard (or home screen) with controllers connected.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / untested until it boots successfully.

risks.risk: Internal storage size and whether it’s expanded unknown (Series S storage varies; expansion changes value).
risks.proof: A screenshot of Settings > System > Storage showing total capacity and any expansion.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the smallest/standard configuration until storage capacity is shown.

risks.risk: Controller condition and charging/battery health unknown (buttons/sticks could be worn; charging could fail).
risks.proof: A clip showing both controllers charging (or battery level changing) and a quick input test (moving sticks, pressing buttons) on-screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controllers with unknown battery/charging health and possible minor wear.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/cables (power cable, HDMI, controller charging accessories) not shown.
risks.proof: A photo laid out showing every included item: power cable, HDMI cable, controller charging method/dongle (if any), and any 'FC26 package' contents.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming missing or unconfirmed accessories; only include what is clearly shown.

risks.risk: Port wear or intermittent faults (HDMI/USB/power port issues) not testable from photos.
risks.proof: A clip showing HDMI output to TV and using at least one USB port (e.g., controller sync/charging) while running.
risks.if_unproven: Price as ports unverified; treat as potential intermittent faults.

risks.risk: Account status / reset status unknown (could be linked to another account or not factory reset).
risks.proof: A screenshot/video of the console during setup or Settings showing it is factory reset / ready for a new owner.
risks.if_unproven: Price as account/reset status unknown (buyer risk) until confirmed.

proof_requests: Photo of the console model label/serial sticker (exact model) and a screenshot of System > Console info.
Video clip: console powers on and boots to the dashboard with both controllers connected.
Screenshot of Settings > System > Storage showing total capacity and whether any expansion is present.
Video clip showing both controllers charging (battery level changes) and a quick on-screen button/stick test.
Clear photos of all included accessories/cables and the full contents of the 'FC26 package' (power cable, HDMI, any charging dongle/cable).
Video clip showing HDMI output working and at least one USB port functioning.
response.reason: The witness can identify the console as an Xbox Series S style unit and shows two controllers, but key value-determining and safety/usage risks (power-on/boot, storage size, controller charging/battery health, included accessories, and reset/account status) are not verifiable from photos alone. Proof is needed before a reliable price.
